metadata.purpose: Implement the thin ScenePattern CreateOffset composition now that the shared Setup primitive is proven.
metadata.instruction: Create aimayatool/tools/scene/create_offset.py and focused Python smoke coverage. Expose deterministic planning/execution for explicit objects plus extra_name. Preserve legacy naming semantics: explicit extraName produces <object><extraName>; empty extraName falls back to <object>ExtraName. Reuse setup.transforms.insert_offset_group; do not duplicate its host mutation logic and do not copy legacy UI/PyMEL/NLTA/JSON plumbing. Missing objects should produce bounded skip evidence rather than aborting unrelated items. Add a zero-argument create_offset_managed_maya_smoke callable that creates a fresh test scene and proves explicit naming, fallback naming, missing-object handling, and world-matrix preservation. Compile/import focused modules, commit and push implementation to main. Do not use Codex.
acceptance: Explicit extraName and legacy fallback naming are deterministic.
Managed Maya smoke callable exists and checks world-matrix preservation plus missing-object handling.
Changed Python compiles/imports and implementation is committed/pushed.
metadata.next_if_pass: Architect reviews committed CreateOffset code and queues managed Maya 2024 validation.
